business_problem: Boat Bike Tours relied on fully manual quote building and service follow-up even as guests expected immediate answers, itinerary flexibility, and personalized travel planning across a growing operation.
solution_summary: Boat Bike Tours is using the Salesforce Platform to turn manual quoting and support workflows into an always-on operations layer. Agentforce pulls live booking, pricing, and availability data from the company's Salesforce environment through Data Cloud, finds the correct tour content, and generates guest quotes in seconds; staff review the quotes today and plan to hand over more of the process over time. The same agent layer is being designed to compare trips, answer itinerary questions, collect missing booking details, and escalate exceptions through Service Cloud flows that send reps the guest's history and request summary. Experience Cloud gives guides direct access to route details, policies, and local knowledge through conversational search, while Net Zero Cloud combines sensor readings, guest counts, and trip data so Tableau can track emissions alongside service operations. That architecture lets the company improve guest experience and sustainability from one data foundation.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Generates quotes, answers traveler questions, and automates frontline support tasks.

solution_components.name: Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Provides the unified booking, pricing, availability, guest, and trip data used by the agents.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Manages customer support hand-offs and service flows when human reps are needed.

solution_components.name: Experience Cloud
solution_components.role: Exposes route details, policies, and knowledge to guides and customers through digital experiences.

solution_components.name: Net Zero Cloud
solution_components.role: Tracks emissions and sustainability data across the boat fleet.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Analyzes service and sustainability data for operational decision-making.

data_flow: Booking, pricing, availability, and guest data is unified in Data Cloud, where Agentforce uses it to generate quotes and respond to support questions. Service Cloud handles escalations, while fleet sensor data and trip metrics flow into Net Zero Cloud and Tableau to monitor emissions and sustainability performance.
business_outcome: Boat Bike Tours can respond faster with personalized quotes and support, free staff to focus on differentiated guest experiences, and use the same Salesforce-centered platform to manage sustainability goals.
architecture_clues: Quote generation currently includes a human review step before customers receive results.
Omnichannel flows decide when last-minute reschedules should escalate to live reps.
Flow meters are installed on 50% of the fleet to feed fuel and electricity data into Net Zero Cloud.
